== [https://github.com/DanRuta/xVA-Synth xVASynth] ==

While the Open Source project supports only English with upcoming [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Phonetic_Alphabet IPA] support. A Lojban voice can be trained by replacing the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ARPABET ARPAbet] dictionary with Lojban equivalent pronunciations. The voice of [[User:Selpahi|la selpa'i]] was synthesized using [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLG78r1RXBYz0fPNhkqvb-cFZylPB4PSHa Lojban Corpus Readings] as audio sources. The English ARPABet dictionaries have to be disabled for it to work properly. 

[[File:xvasynth selpahi example 1.wav|left|thumb]] 

xVASynth voice model: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1Ipk5UvPgorvwnVEaI5Tb1Cc4CKn_raTm

Selpahi dataset: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1Ipk5UvPgorvwnVEaI5Tb1Cc4CKn_raTm


== eSpeak ==

The Open Source eSpeak supports Lojban. 

=== Web Version ===

https://eeejay.github.io/espeak/emscripten/espeak.html

Select the "lojban (jbo)" voice.

=== Command Line Version ===

https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng

: espeak-ng -v jbo

You can then type any Lojban text and press return for it to be read out-loud. Don't press any arrow keys when entering text, as that will cause problems - backspace works fine.

=== GUI Version ===

http://espeak.sourceforge.net/

Type in 'jbo' when installing the languages

== Other software ==

http://members.home.nl/w.dijkhuis/lojban/z0300_txt2speech_01.htm has some more TTS examples.

There is also [[lojban_diphone_speech_synthesizer]] which uses Praat, but a lot of its links are dead now.
